command:
set -eu
work_cfg=/tmp/sshd_config.login-banner.$$
work_issue=/tmp/issue.login-banner.$$
cp -a /etc/ssh/sshd_config "$work_cfg"
if ! grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*Banner[[:space:]]+/etc/issue\.net([[:space:]]|$)' "$work_cfg"; then
  printf '\n# Pre-authentication login warning\nBanner /etc/issue.net\n' >> "$work_cfg"
fi
sshd -t -f "$work_cfg"
[ -e /etc/ssh/sshd_config.before-login-banner ] || cp -a /etc/ssh/sshd_config /etc/ssh/sshd_config.before-login-banner
[ -e /etc/issue.before-login-banner ] || cp -a /etc/issue /etc/issue.before-login-banner
[ -e /etc/issue.net.before-login-banner ] || cp -a /etc/issue.net /etc/issue.net.before-login-banner
install -o root -g root -m 0600 "$work_cfg" /etc/ssh/sshd_config
printf '%s\n' 'Authorized access only' > "$work_issue"
install -o root -g root -m 0644 "$work_issue" /etc/issue
install -o root -g root -m 0644 "$work_issue" /etc/issue.net
restorecon /etc/ssh/sshd_config /etc/issue /etc/issue.net
sshd -t
systemctl reload sshd
rm -f "$work_cfg" "$work_issue"
printf 'configuration_applied=yes\nsshd_reload=completed\n'
